eve: ops question: Dedicated SLA pilot date? planning depends on it.

ana: tentative pilot next month for a small cohort; legal sign-off pending. ops, treat as tentative. i'll update.

sam: playbooks should include an AE escalation template (impact, repro steps, suggested mitigation).

ana: action items: ana to run triage and open tickets; leah+sam to draft fallback demo; priya to own eval checklist; matt to provide billing sample; derek to file partner spec.
